name: codeblue-ai
description: Helps you investigate Amazon EKS issues from the AWS side. It finds what's wrong, shows the evidence, and tells you what to do next. Read-only, and it works with AWS APIs alone, so no kubectl is needed.

aws_profile.title: AWS profile
aws_profile.description: AWS CLI profile the agent uses. Must be a READ-ONLY profile (e.g. ReadOnlyAccess).

aws_mcp_region.title: AWS MCP Server region
aws_mcp_region.description: Region of the AWS MCP Server endpoint. Must be a supported endpoint region (see the README).
